name: TeamStarWolf - Russia-Attributed Threat Actors Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK techniques that the verified public record on Russia-attributed threat actors supports: the techniques ATT&CK v20.0 records for nine Russia-attributed groups (APT28, APT29, Sandworm Team, Turla, Dragonfly, Gamaredon Group, Ember Bear, Star Blizzard, TEMP.Veles) and their eight attributed campaigns, the technique ids named in joint government advisories AA20-296A, AA22-011A, AA23-129A, AA23-341A, AA23-347A, AA24-057A, AA24-249A and AA25-141A, and two techniques inferred by the study. Ids reported under earlier ATT&CK versions are shown under their v20.0 successors from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Campaign C0063 is left out because ATT&CK associates it with no group. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/THREAT_ACTORS_RUSSIA.md. Scores: 100 is named in a government advisory, 60 is recorded by ATT&CK for one of the groups or campaigns but not named in a verified advisory, 30 is inferred by the study.

legendItems.label: 30: inferred by the study from a dated narrative, not an ATT&CK or advisory mapping
60: recorded by ATT&CK for a Russia-attributed group or campaign, not named in a verified advisory
100: named in a joint government advisory on Russian state actors
